# frequencies (144 days of the medium-l program): Rhodes, Kosovichev, Scherrer, Schou &
# Reiter 1997, Solar Physics 175, 287, the electronic table 6b of the paper's SOHO CD-ROM
# version (soho.nascom.nasa.gov/publications/CDROM1/papers/rhodes/table6b.txt), as MESA
# 26.04.1 ships it (data/star_data/solar_csound.data). A published inversion result, not
# a reconstruction: compared with the file at that address on 2026-11-17, all 79 rows of
# the four columns kept are equal. Columns kept: the central radius of the averaging
# kernel, the inferred solar sound speed, its standard error, and the kernel's width.
# Not kept: the sound speed of the inversion's reference model (Model S,
